ios.desc:
Every layoff. As it happens.

The only real-time layoff tracker built for tech professionals, job seekers, investors, and anyone watching the job market. Track company layoffs, job cuts, and workforce reductions the moment they are announced.

REAL-TIME LAYOFF FEED
Browse every layoff as it happens. Each entry shows company, headcount cut, industry, funding stage, country, and a direct link to the original source. Pull to refresh for the latest data.

POWERFUL FILTERS
Narrow down what matters to you:
- Industry: Finance, Healthcare, Tech, Retail and more
- Country: US, India, Germany, 50+ countries
- Funding Stage: Seed through Post-IPO
- Headcount: Small cuts (1-100) to mass layoffs (5,000+)
- Funding Raised: $0-10M up to $100M+
Mix and match any combination. Active filters show as chips you can tap to remove.

VISUAL ANALYTICS
- Monthly layoff trend charts
- Industry breakdown by sector
- Cumulative impact tracker
- Top companies leaderboard ranked by headcount

COMPANY DEEP DIVES
Stage, funding, headcount and verified source links for every company in the database.

YEAR-BY-YEAR DATA
Switch between 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, or view all-time. Every chart and filter updates instantly.

SEARCH AND SAVE
Search any company. Save layoffs you want to follow.

PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Get alerted the moment a new layoff drops.

PRIVACY FIRST
Sign in with Apple. No personal data collected beyond what Apple shares. All data encrypted on Supabase.

Whether you have been laid off, fear being fired, track workforce reductions, monitor company downsizing, or follow tech job cuts as an investor or recruiter - this is the only app built for it.

Download free. Know who's cutting.
